entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship whose crew must escape Rath.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The captain rescued by the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: The Legacy
entities.description: The ancient artifacts that Volrath wishes to reclaim to oppose his hidden master.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The ruler of the Stronghold on Rath who seeks to destroy the crew and reclaim the artifacts.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: The leader who recently reunited the human tribes of the Kor, Vec and Dal.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A noble who accompanied the Weatherlight to Rath and whose newly formed bloodlust threatens the ship.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A mage who stands alone, charged with opening the arcane portal off Rath.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane the crew must leave.

entities.name: Volrath's Stronghold
entities.description: The fortress from which the crew must retreat and that is assaulted by elves and tribes.

entities.name: Kor, Vec and Dal tribes
entities.description: Human tribes recently reunited by Gerrard who assault the Stronghold.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crew, having rescued Sisay and pieces of the Legacy, must retreat through Volrath's Stronghold to the portal off Rath.
events.quote: The crew of the Weatherlight has rescued Captain Sisay and the pieces of the Legacy

events.summary: The Skyshroud elves and the Kor, Vec and Dal tribes assault Volrath's Stronghold.
events.quote: they must also stave off the combined assault of Volrath's Stronghold by the elves of the Skyshroud Forest

events.summary: A change comes over Crovax, whose bloodlust threatens the ship.
events.quote: His newly-formed bloodlust and thirst for power threaten to destroy the entire ship.

events.summary: Ertai stands alone, focused on opening the arcane portal before his comrades return.
events.quote: He must open the arcane portal before his comrades return from the dark fortress

relations.quote: Volrath and his main lieutenant Greven il-Vec

relations.note: Will stop at nothing to destroy the crew.
relations.quote: will stop at nothing to destroy the crew and reclaim the ancient artifacts

relations.note: The tribes were recently reunited by Gerrard.

relations.quote: the noble who accompanied the Weatherlight to Rath
